verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.10
1. At Wares Village
Yokes
“Mendicants, there are these four yokes.
What four?
The yokes of sensual pleasures, future lives, views, and ignorance.
And what is the yoke of sensual pleasures?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kāmānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when you don’t truly understand sensual pleasures’ origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape.

verses.pali: Tassa kāmānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ appajānato yo kāmesu kāmarāgo kāmanandī kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho kāmajjhosānaṁ kāmataṇhā sānuseti.
verses.english: So greed, relishing, affection, infatuation, thirst, passion, attachment, and craving for sensual pleasures linger on inside.
This is called the yoke of sensual pleasures.
Such is the yoke of sensual pleasures.
And what is the yoke of future lives?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco bhavānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when you don’t truly understand future lives’ origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape.

verses.pali: Tassa bhavānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ appajānato yo bhavesu bhavarāgo bhavanandī bhavasneho bhavamucchā bhavapipāsā bhavapariḷāho bhavajjhosānaṁ bhavataṇhā sānuseti.
verses.english: So greed, relishing, affection, infatuation, thirst, passion, attachment, and craving for continued existence linger on inside.
This is called the yoke of future lives.
Such are the yokes of sensual pleasures and future lives.
And what is the yoke of views?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco diṭṭhīnaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when you don’t truly understand views’ origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape.

verses.pali: Tassa diṭṭhīnaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhijjhosānaṁ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.
verses.english: So greed, relishing, affection, infatuation, thirst, passion, attachment, and craving for views linger on inside.
This is called the yoke of views.
Such are the yokes of sensual pleasures, future lives, and views.
And what is the yoke of ignorance?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco channaṁ phassāyatanānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when you don’t truly understand the six fields of contact’s origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape,

verses.pali: Tassa channaṁ phassāyatanānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ appajānato yā chasu phassāyatanesu avijjā aññāṇaṁ sānuseti.
verses.english: so ignorance and unknowing of the six fields of contact linger on inside.
This is called the yoke of ignorance.
Such are the yokes of sensual pleasures, future lives, views, and ignorance.

verses.pali: saṁyutto pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi saṅkilesikehi ponobhavikehi sadarehi dukkhavipākehi āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇikehi. Tasmā ayogakkhemīti vuccati.
verses.english: These are bad, unskillful qualities that are corrupting, leading to future lives, hurtful, resulting in suffering and future rebirth, old age, and death. That’s why someone yoked to them is called: ‘one who has not found sanctuary from the yoke’.
These are the four yokes.
There are these four kinds of unyoking.
What four?
Unyoking from sensual pleasures, future lives, views, and ignorance.
And what is unyoking from sensual pleasures?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kāmānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when you truly understand sensual pleasures’ origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape.

verses.pali: Tassa kāmānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānato yo kāmesu kāmarāgo kāmanandī kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho kāmajjhosānaṁ kāmataṇhā sā nānuseti.
verses.english: So greed, relishing, affection, infatuation, thirst, passion, attachment, and craving for sensual pleasures don’t linger on inside.
This is called unyoking from sensual pleasures.
Such is unyoking from sensual pleasures.
And what is unyoking from future lives?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco bhavānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when you truly understand future lives’ origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape.

verses.pali: Tassa bhavānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānato yo bhavesu bhavarāgo bhavanandī bhavasneho bhavamucchā bhavapipāsā bhavapariḷāho bhavajjhosānaṁ bhavataṇhā sā nānuseti.
verses.english: So greed, relishing, affection, infatuation, thirst, passion, attachment, and craving for continued existence don’t linger on inside.
This is called unyoking from future lives.
Such is unyoking from sensual pleasures and future lives.
And what is unyoking from views?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco diṭṭhīnaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when you truly understand views’ origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape.

verses.pali: Tassa diṭṭhīnaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhijjhosānaṁ diṭṭhitaṇhā sā nānuseti.
verses.english: So greed, relishing, affection, infatuation, thirst, passion, attachment, and craving for views don’t linger on inside.
This is called unyoking from views.
Such is unyoking from sensual pleasures, future lives, and views.
And what is unyoking from ignorance?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco channaṁ phassāyatanānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when you truly understand the six fields of contact’s origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape,

verses.pali: Tassa channaṁ phassāyatanānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānato yā chasu phassāyatanesu avijjā aññāṇaṁ sā nānuseti.
verses.english: so ignorance and unknowing of the six fields of contact don’t linger on inside.
This is called unyoking from ignorance.
Such is unyoking from sensual pleasures, future lives, views, and ignorance.

verses.pali: visaṁyutto pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi saṅkilesikehi ponobhavikehi sadarehi dukkhavipākehi āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇikehi. Tasmā yogakkhemīti vuccati.
verses.english: These are bad, unskillful qualities that are corrupting, leading to future lives, hurtful, resulting in suffering and future rebirth, old age, and death. That’s why someone unyoked from them is called: ‘one who has found sanctuary from the yoke’.
These are the four kinds of unyoking.
Yoked to both sensual pleasures
and the desire to be reborn in a future life;
yoked also to views,
and governed by ignorance,
sentient beings continue to transmigrate,
with ongoing birth and death.
But those who fully understand sensual pleasures,
and the yoke to all future lives;
with the yoke of views eradicated,
and ignorance dispelled,
unyoked from all yokes,
truly those sages have slipped their yoke.”
